rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a strikingly grand visual scene or view.

example.english: The view from this mountaintop is truly dramatic.
example.traditional: 呢個山頂睇出去嘅景色真係好壯觀。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 saan1 deng2 tai2 ceot1 heoi3 ge3 ging2 sik1 zan1 hai6 hou2 zong3 gun1

rows.note: Use this when the striking effect is emotionally powerful or shocking rather than merely grand-looking.

example.english: The ending of that film was really dramatic.
example.traditional: 嗰套戲個結局真係好震撼。
example.jyutping: go2 tou3 hei3 go3 git3 guk6 zan1 hai6 hou2 zan3 ham6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for calling someone's behaviour or reaction overly dramatic.

example.english: You don't need to shout that loudly; that's really dramatic.
example.traditional: 你唔使喊到咁大聲，真係太誇張喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 haam3 dou3 gam3 daai6 seng1 zan1 hai6 taai3 kwaa1 zoeng1 laa3

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression when someone is putting on a show or making their reaction theatrically attention-seeking.

example.english: They make such a dramatic fuss over the slightest fall.
example.traditional: 佢跌親少少就喺度大嗌，真係戲多。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dit3 can1 siu2 siu2 zau6 hai2 dou6 daai6 aai3 zan1 hai6 hei3 do1
